text:
Asha: Quick heads up — search pace dipped ~18% yesterday after the creative swap. We need a coordinated test: layered retarget lists + 2 new creatives + inbound routing check. Thoughts?

Dante: saw that too. pulling query-level and device breakdown now. can we limit test to high-intent queries (branded + 3 top non-branded) to keep signal? Also need exact creative filenames or urls.

AdOps Bot: daily-bid-report.csv uploaded -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads_reports/231987 — CPM +12%, CTR -0.9% vs baseline, conversions unchanged.

Maya: proposed test matrix: Creative A vs Creative B across two retarget lists (30d engaged, 7d page view). 60/40 split control:test and canary on 10% of spend. Landing variants: short headline vs benefit-led. I'll build copy.

Noah: on analytics side: we'll tag cohorts by creative + retarget bucket. plan to run conversion-lift with gclid join to backend leads. will add regression alert if CPL > 25% vs weekly baseline.

Asha: budget and pacing ask: set search budget to $12k/day, retarget $4k/day. Use smoothing: daily_spend_cap = 0.33 (so we don't burn early). Frequency cap on retarget = 3/day. Canary window = 24h.

Dante: OK setting up ad groups in Ads Manager + SA360. Will limit keywords to: `redwood inference`, `llm inference platform`, `inference cost optimization`. Also adding negative match for generic intent.

Dante: webhook mapping for inbound leads — use this curl to test mapping to CRM:
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/inbound \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"source":"ads","gclid":"$GCLID","creative":"A","utm_campaign":"launch_micros"}'
```

Maya: I'll upload creative files to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/launch/q2_microtests (file names: `search_A_v1.jpg`, `search_B_v1.jpg`, `lp_short_A.html`, `lp_benefit_B.html`). Please reference those in the ad setups.

Noah: analytics checklist: create cohorts `search_micro_A`, `search_micro_B`, `rt_30d_A`, `rt_7d_B`. Push daily dashboard tile for CTR, CPC, CPL, and lead-quality ratio. I'll add a Looker alert if CPL delta > 25% for 2 consecutive windows.

Asha: operational notes: - prioritize high-intent kw set during canary - disable auto-bid increases >10% during test - make sure lead webhook responds 200 within 500ms or reroute to fallback queue.

Dante: will pin the rollout plan in the Ads manager and enable hourly pacing checks. setting canary to 10% for first 6 hours then scale to 30% if KPIs look good. :hammer:

Maya: uploading assets now. also drafting 3 short headlines to A/B in the canary: 1) "Ship LLM features fast" 2) "Cut inference cost per token" 3) "Stable, low-latency LLM serving".

Noah: adding cohort labels + dashboard now. ETA dashboards by 10am PT tomorrow. will flag anomalies in this channel. :bell:

Asha: Great. Next steps: Dante deploy canary + webhook mapping by 5pm PT today; Maya creative assets + landing variants by EOD; Noah dashboards & alerts before canary. Ping here when done. :rocket:

Dante: on it.

Maya: done uploading, shared links in drive, tagging creative versions. :cloud_upload:

Noah: dashboards in progress, alerts queued. will post link when live.

Asha: thanks team — will monitor first 6h and decide scale. keep updates brief here.
